footer.tagline: Smart recipe management for modern households.

hero.subtitle: CoPantry collects your recipes, tracks your pantry, and plans your meals — so you save time, waste less food, and always know what to cook next.

features.title: One app for your entire kitchen
features.subtitle: From saving a recipe to filling your cart — everything in one place.
features.ai_import_desc: Paste a URL, take a photo, or copy raw text — AI extracts every ingredient and step in seconds. Supports YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and 50,000+ recipe sites.
features.pantry_desc: Track what you have with expiry dates. Get alerts before food goes bad. Cook from what you already own with zero-waste recipe suggestions.
features.calendar_desc: Plan breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the whole household. Confirm meals to auto-deduct ingredients from your pantry — no manual updates.
features.shopping_desc: Generate shopping lists from your meal plan in one tap. Share with family members in real time.
features.multilingual_desc: Collect recipes from Italian blogs, Japanese cookbooks, French magazines. The recipe stays in its original language; the UI adapts to yours.
features.ai_desc: Connect Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP-compatible assistant to manage your kitchen by voice. Completely optional — the app works perfectly without it.

how.title: How it works
how.step1_desc: Import from any URL, photo, or raw text. AI parses ingredients, steps, and timing automatically. Your entire cookbook in one place.
how.step2_desc: Add recipes to your meal calendar. The pantry auto-updates when you confirm a meal. See your shopping list generate itself.
how.step3_desc: Connect Claude or any MCP-compatible assistant to manage your kitchen by voice. Works great without it too.

platform.title: A platform, not just an app
platform.subtitle: CoPantry is infrastructure for the way households will interact with AI — starting with the kitchen.
platform.point1_desc: As AI assistants become household staples, CoPantry is the integration layer between AI and your kitchen data.
platform.point2_desc: Every member who joins increases the value of shared pantry, calendar, and shopping data for the whole family.
platform.point3_desc: Plans scale with AI usage. Developers building on CoPantry's MCP server drive recurring API revenue alongside household subscriptions.

spotlight.optional_note: Most users love CoPantry without ever touching this. For those who want it:
spotlight.desc: Connect Claude Desktop, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible AI client to unlock hands-free kitchen management. 10 tools covering recipes, pantry, meal planning, and shopping.
examples: "Plan a waste-free week using what's in my pantry"

"Generate my shopping list for next week"

faq.q: What counts as an AI action?
faq.a: Every tool invocation from an MCP client (Claude, Cursor, npx, or raw HTTP) counts as one action. Simply viewing the app or importing a recipe from the browser does not consume AI actions.

faq.q: What happens when I hit the monthly limit?
faq.a: AI tool calls will return a 429 response. Your app usage (recipes, pantry, meal planning in the browser) is never affected. Upgrade any time to restore access immediately.

faq.q: Can I change plans at any time?
faq.a: Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately and are prorated. Downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing period.

faq.q: Is there an annual billing option?
faq.a: Annual billing with a 20% discount is coming soon. Subscribe to our newsletter to be notified.

mcp.user_intro_title: You don't need this to use CoPantry.
mcp.user_intro_desc: CoPantry is a recipe and meal planning app that anyone can use from a browser or phone. This page explains how to optionally connect an AI assistant like ChatGPT or Claude, so you can run CoPantry by just asking. You add it yourself as a custom connector — there is no agent to build and no code to write — and it stays optional: the app works perfectly without it.
mcp.setup_subtitle: Two ways to connect. Most people only need the first.
mcp.step1_desc: Log in to CoPantry and go to Settings → AI & MCP. Name your key (e.g. "Claude Desktop"), then copy it — it is only shown once.
mcp.step3_desc: Restart your MCP client (Claude Desktop requires a full restart). Then try:
mcp.step3_example: "Search my CoPantry recipes for something with chicken and schedule it for dinner tomorrow."
mcp.ready_desc: Add CoPantry as a custom connector in your assistant, or grab an API key for a file-configured client. Either way, it takes about a minute.
mcp.ready_note: Free to connect · No credit card required · A monthly limit applies to AI actions
mcp.what_ai_title: What your AI assistant can do
mcp.what_ai_subtitle: Once connected, your AI assistant can handle these requests without you opening the app:
mcp.connector_title: Add CoPantry to your assistant as a custom connector
mcp.connector_lede: CoPantry is not listed in ChatGPT's or Claude's built-in connector directory yet — but you do not have to wait for that, and you do not need to build an agent. Both let you add a custom MCP server yourself. It takes about a minute and needs no API key, no config file and no code.
mcp.connector_step1: Open your assistant's connector settings and choose to add a custom or remote MCP server. In Claude that is Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector; in ChatGPT it is under Settings → Connectors, where availability depends on your plan.
mcp.connector_step2: Paste the CoPantry MCP address below as the server URL.
mcp.connector_step3: Sign in with your CoPantry account and approve access. Then just ask, in your normal chat: “What can I cook tonight with what I have?”
mcp.connector_note: Your assistant signs in through CoPantry's own approval screen, so no key is stored in the client and you can revoke access at any time in Settings → AI & MCP.
mcp.manual_title: Prefer a config file? Connect with an API key
mcp.manual_lede: For desktop and coding clients that are set up through a file — Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf — or for your own scripts.
